description: This file defines the ClientRepository class responsible for database operations related to Client entities within the project. It includes methods for fetching, inserting, updating, and deleting client records from the 'organisation' table, utilizing SQL queries and prepared statements.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing Client data in the database, providing CRUD operations and specialized queries on the 'organisation' table.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all client records ordered by name.

methods.name: findByType
methods.description: Fetches clients filtered by the 'kind' attribute, including a count of contacts per client.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a client by its ID, joining with user data for creator information.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a client record based on its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new client record into the database.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates a client record identified by its ID with provided values.
